concerns.text: Task T022 applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction to 'all unadjusted p-values (from T020, T020a, T021)'. T021 (PERMANOVA) produces a single community-level p-value, not a set of taxa-level tests. Applying BH correction to a single value or mixing community-level and taxa-level p-values violates FR-005's scope ('across all taxa') and SC-002's logic. The task must restrict BH correction to taxa-level p-values only.

Task T037 measures runtime from 'start of T012 to end of T030'. SC-004 requires measuring the 'full analysis pipeline' runtime against a ≤ 4h threshold. If the conditional validation step (US4, T031-T034) is accessible and executed, T037's window excludes this time, artificially satisfying the constraint while the actual pipeline exceeds it. The measurement window must include the conditional validation block if executed.

Task T031 attempts to validate against 'UK Biobank' or 'MetaHIT' via HuggingFace. Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) mandates that every external citation be verified by the Reference-Validator Agent before use. T031 lacks a sub-task or dependency to run the validator on these URLs before download, creating a direct violation of the constitutional gate for external data sources.

Spec FR-003 requires calculation of 'UniFrac' (both weighted and unweighted) metrics. Task T016b generates 'beta_distances.npz' but does not explicitly verify the generation of the *unweighted* UniFrac matrix as a distinct artifact or verify its presence in the output. Given the strict requirement for both metrics, the task must explicitly ensure both weighted and unweighted matrices are generated and logged.
